independentReview: none for G1-R itself; this round implements the independent review of G1. See review-notes.md.
scope: measurement tooling and CI only. No classifier, threshold, prompt, routing, fixture, scorer, DB or UI change.
disclaimer: Every run is offline: the quality test makes executeLlmChain throw, the database is mocked, and the command blanks seven provider API keys before vitest starts. Token figures are zero by construction and are not a production cost; latency is local and is not a production p95. No real audio, transcript, key or user data was used or written. G1-R did not change the classifier and did not move its accuracy.

npmCiFinding.severity: out of scope, reported not fixed
npmCiFinding.claim: npm ci fails on main as committed
npmCiFinding.proof: run in a clean linux container against 6f17a26 with the two G1 scripts stripped from package.json: 'npm error Missing: @capacitor/cli@8.5.1 from lock file'
npmCiFinding.impact: the npm ci step of every CI job would fail today, not only the classification job
npmCiFinding.notFixedBecause: a dependency/lockfile change is outside this round
npmCiFinding.workaround: the Linux demonstration used npm install

resolution.why: point 3 cannot be completed while npm ci fails: it is step one of every CI job, so the workflow could never reach a run step.
resolution.change: npm install --package-lock-only, adding the lock entry for @capacitor/cli which package.json already declares
resolution.blastRadius: 62 lock entries added, 0 removed, 3 changed. No version changed. The three changes are the root devDependencies list gaining @capacitor/cli, and two packages moving from optional to devOptional because they became reachable from a dev dependency.
resolution.verified: npm ci exits 0 in a clean node:22-bookworm container
resolution.notADependencyChange: no dependency was added, removed or re-versioned; the lock was made to agree with a package.json that already declared it

limitations: GitHub Actions was NOT run. The YAML is parsed and validated and every step succeeds locally on Windows and in a node:22-bookworm container, which is not the same thing.
Offline only. Zero tokens is a property of the harness, not of production cost.
derivedLlmRoutes is inferred from parsedBy and cannot see retries or failover.
frozen is no longer an independent holdout; it was used during regression diagnosis in the core round.
tripleF1 does not measure currency, date, or whether a row saved correctly.
The whole-project lint, npm run test, e2e and build were not run.
G1-R changed no classifier behaviour and therefore moved no accuracy figure.
